rationale.risk-routing: Edit-likelihood thresholds select tokens warranting heightened human scrutiny.
rationale.ai-review: A separate probabilistic model judges which generated tokens likely require editing.
rationale.oversight-explanation: Inline highlights provide standing information supporting human judgment of completions.
rationale.automation-bias: Programmers treated absent highlights as evidence that code was correct.
rationale.survey-input: Programmers reported substantive preferences for granular, interpretable, non-overwhelming highlights.
rationale.built-system: Authors implemented an edit model and functional highlighting interface.
rationale.assistive: Programmers edited suggestion-granularity completions within an interactive coding flow.
rationale.metrics: Defines edit probability measuring quality-related likelihood that tokens require modification.
rationale.risk-quality: The intervention targets generated-code bugs and evaluates correctness and editing outcomes.
rationale.risk-overreliance: Empirical observations show possible undue reliance on incomplete highlighting signals.
rationale.method-self-report: Questionnaires and interviews captured workload, utility, rankings, and design preferences.
rationale.method-experiment: Programmers completed controlled tasks under randomized within-subject highlighting conditions.
